# PerchTV 0.1.33

The phone hears "failed" only when the television gives up, and a Samsung television stops retrying a stream that keeps freezing.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Android TV, the phone no longer shows a cast as failed while the television is still trying to get the stream back. It hears "failed" only when the television gives up.
- On Samsung televisions, the five tries to get a stream back are earned back only after about half a minute of picture that keeps moving. Before, a stream that froze after roughly 15 to 30 seconds of picture earned them back each time, so the television could retry it without end.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything in 0.1.32: the reconnect card staying up between tries, the card that says what the stream is doing, a stuck picture reconnecting by itself, and a live channel the provider ends reconnecting at once.
